  - Coordinator for Final Year Research Projects and Second Year Software Development Project.
- Software Engineering Intern, Archnix (Pvt.) Ltd. — Feb 2024 - Aug 2024
  - Developed an internal admin dashboard for an online delivery service, including a full site redesign using React, implementing RBAC and integrating external third-party APIs
  - Created backend APIs for an in-house recruitment system using Node.js and Sequalize ORM, for user management with JWT-based authentication and email verification
  - Built a full-stack healthcare-service locator using React, Node, MySQL and Google Maps API
- BSc in Computer Science, University of Sri Jayawardenepura — Jan 2020 - Oct 2024
  - Graduated with Second Class Upper Division Honours (GPA: 3.54/4.00).
